tasks.label: Biscene-LP Dev Check
tasks.command: export PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/node@20/bin:$PATH" && echo 'cwd:' && pwd && ls -ld node_modules && if [ -L node_modules ]; then echo 'TYPE=SYMLINK'; else echo 'TYPE=REALDIR'; fi && curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'HTTP3000:%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:3000/ || true
